title: Result page
text:
#| '!! shinylive warning !!': |
#|   shinylive does not work in self-contained HTML documents.
#|   Please set `embed-resources: false` in your metadata.
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 700
library(shiny)
library(rmarkdown)
library(readr)
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)
shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    selectInput("year_input", label = "Select year", choices = NULL),
    selectInput("eclipse_input", label = "Select eclipse", choices = NULL),
    #tableOutput("detail_output"),
    plotOutput("eclipse_sun", width = "300px", height = "300px"),
    plotlyOutput("eclipse_map", width = "300px", height = "300px"),
  ),

  server = function(input, output, session) {
    # year (static)
    updateSelectInput(session, "year_input", choices = sort(years))

    # eclipses that happened in the selected year
    year_rows <- reactive({
      req(input$year_input)
      eclipses[eclipses$Year == as.integer(input$year_input), ]
    })

    observe({
      df <- year_rows()
      labels <- paste0(format(df$Date, "%Y-%m-%d"), " (", df$Type, ")")
      choices <- setNames(format(df$Date, "%Y-%m-%d"), labels)
      updateSelectInput(
        session,
        "eclipse_input",
        label = "Select eclipse",
        choices = choices
      )
    })

    # eclipse the user picked
    selected_row <- reactive({
      req(input$eclipse_input)
      year_rows()[format(year_rows()$Date, "%Y-%m-%d") == input$eclipse_input, ]
    })

    # --- "consequent actions" go here --------
    output$detail_output <- renderTable({
      req(selected_row())
      selected_row()[, c("Type", "Gamma", "Magnitude", "Latitude", "Longitude")]
    })

    output$eclipse_sun <- renderPlot({
      req(selected_row())

      # Extract data
      mag <- as.numeric(selected_row()$Magnitude)
      tp <- (selected_row()$Type)

      plot_magnitude(mag, tp)
    })

    output$eclipse_map <- renderPlotly({
      req(selected_row())

      # Extract data
      tp <- (selected_row()$Type)
      dt <- as.character(selected_row()$Date)
      url <- construct_url(dt, tp)

      plot_path(url)
    })
  },
  options = list(height = 600)
)
